# Troubleshooting

## The camera won't read the text

- Hold the phone steady and closer to the text.
- Tap **Freeze camera**, then pick the words.
- Turn on the **Torch** in low light.
- Tap **Type it instead** if it still can't read it.

## The camera is blocked

If Deaftly says camera access is blocked, tap **Open settings** and allow the camera for Deaftly. See [Reading text with the camera](camera.md).

## The app won't install

Make sure you've allowed installs from the app you used to download it. Search your phone's Settings for "Install unknown apps". See [Installing and updating](installing-and-updating.md).

## Android says the app conflicts or the signatures don't match

Stop. The file didn't come from Deaftly. Don't uninstall your copy. Download it again from the download page. See [Installing and updating](installing-and-updating.md).

## A built-in template has gone

If you deleted it, tap **Restore built-in templates** in [Settings](settings.md).

## Something else is wrong

Tell us through the feedback form on the Deaftly website, and include your app version if you can.
